ground_truth_reconciliation: GT#1-#3 (registry counts, config surfaces, connect failures) not re-probed — orthogonal to script housing. GT#4 (process pile-ups via mcp_doctor.py audit): instrument located (~/.local/opt/re-harness/mcp_doctor.py) and confirmed local-only by two independent probes (direct dir listing + validated full-tree filename walk) — no refutation, but the instrument itself is unversioned (finding 2). GT#5 (agents CLI drops zcode/hermes targets): corroborated incidentally — agents.json 'agent-mail' targets include zcode+hermes, the exact targets GT#5 says get dropped; not independently re-measured by me (different mechanism would be 'agents doctor' re-run, out of READ-ONLY comfort for this lane). summary: The scatter is asymmetric. monitorcore is the model citizen: repo-housed at tools/monitorcore with a deliberate vendor-propagate pipeline into skills/workflow-monitor (38-file subset), correctly deployed to ~/.agents/skills — its only defects are a 1-file live drift (redact.py), a repo-internal .agents mirror one edit behind (codex_monitor shim 714b vs 730b), and junk strays (a .coverage-only dir). The mingle side is the risk concentration: the third-party mcp_agent_mail clone is correctly pinned (HEAD==PINNED_COMMIT 35e774f, clean), but the always-on rail's supervisor — executed by Scheduled Task MCPAgentMailSupervisor — lives in an UNTRACKED layer inside that clone with zero versioned copies anywhere, and its duplicate in mingle/agentmail has drifted (13,246b vs live 16,862b). re-harness (incl. mcp_doctor, the instrument behind this audit's own ground-truth probe #4) and the whole mingle wrapper suite are local-only with path-lock from 7+ skills. Priority order: (1) version the live agentmail_supervisor.ps1 + estate layer into the repo and deploy-in; (2) version mcp_doctor + re-harness source; (3) house mingle doctor/relay; (4) re-run vendor sync for redact.py and refresh the repo .agents mirror; (5) fix the 8812->18812 doc drift in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md. No config was modified; all probes read-only.
